ShortDescription.Value: Export the current city with Carto and explore it in your browser.

Publish.LongDescription:
SKYLENS MAPS opens your city map with **ONE CLICK**.
### Features
- Search all buildings, roads, stations and routes in your city - Search driving and transit routes, just like using Google Maps in the real world - View transit layers
### How to Use
- choose Options > SKYLENS MAPS and click LAUNCH SKYLENS MAPS. Done. - The initial map generation may take about 30 seconds
### Required Mods
* Carto must be installed
### Open Source Contributions
- If you have any ideas for new features or performance improvements, feel free to leave issues or PRs at [github repo](https://github.com/ganjanggejang/skylens-maps) - Please report errors/bugs at [issues](https://github.com/ganjanggejang/skylens-maps/issues) . Thank you
### Korean Description
단 한 번의 클릭으로 지도를 사용해보세요
기능
- 모든 건물, 도로, 대중교통 역/정류장, 도로 검색 - 네이버 지도/구글 지도를 사용하듯 길찾기 - 대중교통 노선 보기
사용법
- 옵션 > SKYLENS MAPS 에서 LAUNCH SKYLENS MAPS 클릭만 하면 끝입니다. - 처음 지도 생성 시 30초 정도 소요됩니다.

Publish.ChangeLog: Added transit mode icons for bus, train, tram, subway, ship, and ferry. Improved transport facility route discovery, including harbor and ferry services, and added navigation back to nearby routes. Added zoom-dependent labels for named buildings and subway stations, with better label ranking and overlap handling. Fixed road and routing support for tram and bicycle lanes.
